purpose: Response-blind deep EML audit after v1 stopped before CSV access; inspect only measurement scales, bounds, missing-value codes and stable-unit definitions.

decision_rule.stable_unit: Location + Transect + Quadrat must be defined without date and Quadrat must be permanent/repeated.
decision_rule.focal_taxon: Zostera marina represented by metadata-declared code ZM.
decision_rule.quantitative_state: Percent Cover must have a declared numeric scale and missing-code semantics.
decision_rule.eligible_target_observation: same permanent unit in next year has at least one declared species observation; absence of ZM may then be interpreted only as 'ZM not observed among recorded seagrass species', never bare-habitat absence.
decision_rule.stop_if: metadata cannot support the narrower re-observed vegetated-quadrat transition without inspecting CSV values.

no_rescue: Do not open the CSV in this gate.
Do not infer bare-quadrat observations from missing rows.
Do not change focal taxon after CSV access.
Any future endpoint must be frozen before CSV access.
